body:
This should also use `PROPERTY_USAGE_NONE`.
EDIT:
Or actually why is it even a property, if it's not really supposed to be used (internal)?

Hm, I'll have to look into that again/further since it's been a while since I worked on this - I think I was mostly just copying what looked like relevant code to add my feature 😅 

My idea here, I believe, was to allow the user to access `volume_linear` for things like linearly fading a bus's volume  using a tween.
But this property is not exposed, so it's unlikely user would use it. They will use the `set_bus_volume_linear()` method.

Ah, yes I see what you mean as I look back at the code again. My hope was to be able to fade the volume out with something like
```gdscript
# Fades out over 1 second
tween.tween_property(audio_bus_layout, "bus/0/volume_linear", 0.0, 1.0)
```
But, looking at my testing code for this feature, I see that you have to save the bus layout *back* to the AudioServer after modifying its properties, which prevents it from being (easily) tweenable as far as I know. Thus, if you don't  think it makes sense to have the `volume_linear` property for AudioBusLayout, I can remove it.

In the future, though, might it make sense to propose a modification to the way that the AudioServer/AudioBusLayout system works, so that a snippet like I provided above would be viable? `set_bus_volume_linear()` may work along with `tween_method` but I think it does have some drawbacks, notably requiring an explicit start value instead of being able to interpolate from whatever the value was when the tween started.

> Thus, if you don't think it makes sense to have the volume_linear property for AudioBusLayout, I can remove it.

Yeah remove it. It's not very useful if its not documented anywhere.

body:
```suggestion
			[b]Note:[/b] This member modifies [member volume_db] for convenience. The returned value is equivalent to the result of [method @GlobalScope.db_to_linear] on [member volume_db]. Setting this member is equivalent to setting [member volume_db] to the result of [method @GlobalScope.linear_to_db] on a value.
```
For all these, a bit too verbose (which makes translation harder)
